data.title: 蕾娜·莉希特娜瓦 · 一起画的地图
data.description: 你们把去过的地方标在地图上。蕾娜又在空白处画了一个小圈，问下次能不能一起去那里；这回她特意把路线也记清楚了。
data.action: 又在空白处画了一个小圈，问下次能不能一起去那里；这回她特意把路线也记清楚了
data.promptProse: Seated comfortably at a warm wooden table in the evening in her light blue cardigan and white shirt, Lena leans over a wide unfolded paper map already dotted with small hand-drawn notes. Resting the tip of a wooden pencil beside a freshly circled spot along the margin, she looks up toward the viewer with an eager, expectant smile. A shaded desk lamp casts a cozy golden circle across the folded route lines and her hands.
data.animaCaption: Leaning over an unfolded travel map at the wooden table, Lena rests her pencil beside a freshly circled destination and looks up at the viewer with an eager smile. Warm desk lamplight pools over the paper route and her light blue cardigan.
